name: Fay
source:
"I know it's an important mission, but it's not for me to be troublesome like that~"

A wind spirit who is in a good mood when the wind blows, in a bad mood when it's raining, gets upset when angry, and smiles when something is funny. A girl who expresses honestly without covering up. Although she is impulsive, capricious, and lacks concentration, she has a refreshing personality like a broken bamboo. Even when she's angry, she doesn't hold much root. She easily can talk to anyone and quickly become friends with them, but she is not good with people who are not friendly. 

[Translated from the [url=https://www.vridge.co.jp/homepage/contents/products/eg/chara_8.htm]official website[/url]]
